description: This file implements a support module for calculating Modulation and Coding Scheme (MCS) indices based on CQI and SNR values, including mappings and tables for different MCS configurations, as well as functions for mapping CQI to MCS and SNR to MCS.

methods.name: ocudu::map_cqi_to_mcs
methods.description: Maps CQI value to MCS index based on specified MCS table.

methods.name: ocudu::map_snr_to_mcs_ul
methods.description: Determines the maximum MCS index that can be used for a given uplink SNR, considering different MCS tables.
